test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the correct combination of letters to sequentially replace the blanks and to make the given series logically complete.

M _ J _ M _ _ M _ M _ _
solution:
**Given :** M _ J _ M _ _ M _ M _ _

**By checking options :**

 
• MJMJMJM → M __**M**__ J __**J**__ M __**M**__ __**J**__ M **__M__** M __**J**__ __**M**__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• MMJMJMJ → M __M__ J **__M__** M **__J__** **__M__** M **__J__** M **__M__** **__J__** → (It follows the pattern of : MMJ - MMJ - MMJ - MMJ)
 
• JMJJMJM → M **__J__** J **__M__** M **__J__** __J__ M __M__ M __J__ __M__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• JJMJMMJ → M **__J__** J __J__ M __M__ __J__ M __M__ M **__M__** **__J__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (2) gives the pattern of "M __M__ J - __M__ M __J__ - __M__ M __J__ - M __M__ __J__"

Hence,** "MMJMJMJ"** is the correct answer.
